_about: Red Poster (Top-100 #7, r30 snippco, work-life motivational, score 9) v2, 8 Oct 2026, matched frame by frame: the speaker in BLACK AND WHITE, cut out inside a wide red card on a white page (small red serif lead above, a huge bold white word over the card, a red serif tail below), or cut out on a full red page with one huge bold white word at the top; between them, moody dark cinematic cutaways carrying small serif + bold white sans captions. No header, no name tag. Sound like the ref (demucs): a keys bed ~13 dB under the voice (alif-match-a, distance 4.9), no sound effects.

director.style: Red Poster: a red-and-white motivational poster cut. The speaker is never shown raw: always black-and-white and cut out, in a wide red card on a white page or on a full red page; between, moody dark cinematic cutaways carry the words.
director.speaker: Every speaker stretch is EITHER a stack scene (bg card, cutout true, pageBg #FFFFFF, cardBg #C8102E, cardW 980, cardH 560, cardTop 660, cutoutSrc assets/card-cut.webm (run make_card_cut.sh <project> 980 560 <scale> <top> bw first: head and shoulders baked in, B&W; also makes the full matte B&W), cutoutScale 1.0, textAbove true, y 300 (the words sit fully above the card): lead = the small red serif words, key = ONE huge bold RED word (keyColor #C8102E) just above the card (white is invisible on the white page), tail = the rest in red serif, keyMax 210 (auto-fits long words), cardIn cut) OR a ground beat color #C8102E with text = ONE word in caps (textColor #FFFFFF, textSize 300, textY 150) with sfx none.
director.cutaways: Between them, image scenes (captions: true, in cut, out cut, 1.3-2.0 s, grade contrast(1.1) brightness(0.7) saturate(0.85)): dark, moody, cinematic (people at screens at night, a runner, a city at night, a laptop desk, a window at dusk). Alternate card, cutaway, card, cutaway; a red full page 1-2 times.
director.captions: Over cutaways: small serif lead words + ONE bold white sans hero per phrase (captions.heroes, never filler). Lowercase.
director.sound: music alif-match-a -13 dB; no sound effects (sfx none on grounds, no inSfx).
